question: What exalted beings or status may the practitioner attain through this practice?
premises: Divine maidens of the gods are involved
The status of yakṣa or vidyādhara is possible
inference: The practitioner may attain association with divine maidens and become like a yakṣa or vidyādhara.
uncertainties: deva+kanyā may be subject or object in this compressed verse
plain_english: He may become associated with divine maidens of the gods and become a yakṣa or vidyādhara.
